english.title: Knowingly / recklessly make a false statement to an officer under the Property Misdescriptions Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in giving information to an enforcement officer under paragraph 5(1)(c) of the Schedule to the Property Misdescriptions Act 1991 made a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly made a statement which was false, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3 of, and paragraph 5(3) and (4) of the Schedule to, the Property Misdescriptions Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
in giving information to an enforcement officer
under paragraph 5(1)(c) of the Schedule to the Property Misdescriptions Act 1991
made a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular OR
recklessly made a statement which was false

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 5 of the Property Misdescriptions Act 1991 provides that the time limit on prosecutions is three years beginning with the date of commission of the offence or the end of the period of one year beginning with the date of the discovery of the offence by the prosecutor, whichever is the earlier.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gwneud datganiad anwir gan wybod hynny / yn fyrbwyll i swyddog dan Ddeddf Camddisgrifiadau Eiddo 1991
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) wrth roi gwybodaeth i swyddog gorfodi dan baragraff 5(1)(c) yr Atodlen i Ddeddf Camddisgrifiadau Eiddo 1991 bu i chi wneud datganiad a chithau'n gwybod ei fod yn anwir, neu bu i chi yn fyrbwyll wneud datganiad anwir, mewn manylyn perthnasol, sef **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE STATEMENT..)
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 3, a pharagraff 5(3) a (4) yr Atodlen i Ddeddf Camddisgrifiadau Eiddo 1991.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
